name: code-editor-typing
title: Code Editor Typing
description: A full code editor window (activity bar, explorer, tabs, terminal, status bar) types a snippet character by character with a caret, then tilts in 3D.
useWhen: A developer-facing video needs a believable code editor typing out a snippet.
The code should be easy to swap (one text variable).
avoidWhen: You want a glass code card or a morphing diff: use glass-code-block or code-morph.
The snippet is longer than about 18 lines.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Code
variables.description: The code that gets typed, up to 18 lines (a small Python-style highlighter colours it).

variables.label: File name
variables.description: Name on the tab and in the file tree.

variables.label: Project name
variables.description: Name in the title bar, explorer and breadcrumbs.

variables.label: Note
variables.description: Small caption on the right of the title.
variables.default: Typing a small file, with a tests terminal below.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Active tab, status bar and activity bar accent.

variables.label: Background glow
variables.description: Light colour of the backdrop behind the window.

variables.label: Background base
variables.description: Dark colour of the backdrop behind the window.
